_comment: Curated catalog of Google Cloud products. `icon` refers to an icon id from the official Google Cloud icon pack (https://cloud.google.com/icons). `icon_approx: true` means no dedicated icon exists in the official pack yet, so the closest official icon is used. `docs` are official cloud.google.com documentation entry points.

products.name: Compute Engine
products.summary: Virtual machines running in Google's data centers; managed instance groups, autoscaling, custom machine types.

products.name: Cloud GPUs
products.summary: NVIDIA GPUs attached to Compute Engine VMs or GKE nodes for ML training, inference and HPC.

products.name: Cloud TPU
products.summary: Google-designed accelerators for large-scale ML training and inference.

products.name: Batch
products.summary: Fully managed batch job scheduling and execution on Compute Engine.

products.name: Google Cloud VMware Engine
products.summary: Run VMware workloads natively on dedicated Google Cloud infrastructure.

products.name: Bare Metal Solution
products.summary: Dedicated bare-metal servers in a regional extension, typically for Oracle workloads.

products.name: App Engine
products.summary: Fully managed platform for web applications (standard and flexible environments).

products.name: Cloud Run
products.summary: Serverless containers: services (HTTP), jobs, and worker pools with scale-to-zero and request-based autoscaling.

products.name: Cloud Run functions
products.summary: Event-driven functions-as-a-service (formerly Cloud Functions), built on Cloud Run.

products.name: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
products.summary: Managed Kubernetes with Autopilot and Standard modes, regional clusters, Workload Identity.

products.name: GKE Enterprise
products.summary: Fleet management, policy, service mesh and multi-cluster capabilities for GKE and attached clusters (formerly Anthos).

products.name: Artifact Registry
products.summary: Universal package and container image repository with vulnerability scanning.

products.name: Cloud Storage
products.summary: Object storage with Standard/Nearline/Coldline/Archive classes, dual/multi-region buckets, Object Lifecycle Management.

products.name: Filestore
products.summary: Managed NFS file storage for Compute Engine and GKE.

products.name: Google Cloud NetApp Volumes
products.summary: Fully managed NFS/SMB file storage service built on NetApp ONTAP.

products.name: Persistent Disk / Hyperdisk
products.summary: Block storage for VMs: Persistent Disk and Hyperdisk (Balanced, Extreme, Throughput, ML).

products.name: Local SSD
products.summary: Ephemeral, physically attached high-IOPS SSDs for VMs.

products.name: Storage Transfer Service
products.summary: Online transfers between object stores, file systems and Cloud Storage.

products.name: Transfer Appliance
products.summary: Physical appliance for offline, large-scale data transfer into Cloud Storage.

products.name: Backup and DR Service
products.summary: Centralized backup and disaster recovery for VMs, databases and file systems.

products.name: Cloud SQL
products.summary: Managed MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server with HA, read replicas and Enterprise Plus edition.

products.name: AlloyDB for PostgreSQL
products.summary: PostgreSQL-compatible database for demanding transactional and analytical (HTAP) workloads.

products.name: Spanner
products.summary: Globally distributed, strongly consistent relational database with 99.999% multi-region SLA.

products.name: Bigtable
products.summary: Wide-column NoSQL database for low-latency, high-throughput key/value and time-series workloads.

products.name: Firestore
products.summary: Serverless document database with real-time sync, offline support and MongoDB compatibility.

products.name: Datastore
products.summary: Legacy NoSQL document database (Firestore in Datastore mode).

products.name: Memorystore
products.summary: Managed Redis, Redis Cluster, Valkey and Memcached for caching and session storage.

products.name: Database Migration Service
products.summary: Serverless migrations to Cloud SQL, AlloyDB and Spanner, including heterogeneous migrations.

products.name: BigQuery
products.summary: Serverless enterprise data warehouse with BigQuery ML, BI Engine, Omni and built-in Gemini features.

products.name: Dataflow
products.summary: Managed Apache Beam for unified batch and streaming data processing.

products.name: Dataproc
products.summary: Managed Spark, Hadoop, Flink and Trino, including Dataproc Serverless.

products.name: Pub/Sub
products.summary: Global, scalable asynchronous messaging and event ingestion.

products.name: Cloud Composer
products.summary: Managed Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.

products.name: Cloud Data Fusion
products.summary: Code-free, visual data integration (ETL/ELT) based on CDAP.

products.name: Dataplex Universal Catalog
products.summary: Data governance, cataloging, lineage, data quality and lake management.

products.name: Datastream
products.summary: Serverless change data capture (CDC) and replication into BigQuery and Cloud Storage.

products.name: Dataform
products.summary: SQL-based ELT pipeline development and orchestration in BigQuery.

products.name: Dataproc Metastore
products.summary: Fully managed Apache Hive metastore.

products.name: Analytics Hub
products.summary: Secure data exchange and sharing of BigQuery datasets across organizations.

products.name: Looker
products.summary: Enterprise BI platform with a governed semantic layer (LookML).

products.name: Looker Studio
products.summary: Self-service dashboards and reporting (formerly Data Studio).

products.name: Dataprep
products.summary: Visual data preparation service by Trifacta.

products.name: Vertex AI

products.name: Gemini on Vertex AI
products.summary: Gemini models, grounding, RAG Engine, tuning and evaluation on Vertex AI.

products.name: Vertex AI Agent Builder / Agent Engine
products.summary: Build, deploy and manage agents (ADK, Agent Engine runtime, Agent Garden).

products.name: Vertex AI Search
products.summary: Google-quality enterprise search and RAG over your data (AI Applications).

products.name: Document AI
products.summary: Document understanding, OCR and extraction with pretrained and custom processors.

products.name: Cloud Vision API
products.summary: Image labeling, OCR, face/landmark detection and SafeSearch.

products.name: Cloud Natural Language API
products.summary: Entity, sentiment, syntax and content classification.

products.name: Speech-to-Text
products.summary: Speech recognition with Chirp models.

products.name: Text-to-Speech
products.summary: Natural-sounding speech synthesis.

products.name: Cloud Translation
products.summary: Text and document translation, including adaptive and LLM-based translation.

products.name: Video Intelligence API
products.summary: Video annotation, shot detection, object tracking and text detection.

products.name: Dialogflow CX / Conversational Agents
products.summary: Build conversational agents for chat and voice.

products.name: Contact Center AI / CCAI Platform
products.summary: AI-powered contact center capabilities: virtual agents, Agent Assist, insights.

products.name: Vertex AI Search for commerce
products.summary: Retail search, browse and recommendations.

products.name: Recommendations AI
products.summary: Personalized product recommendations (part of Vertex AI Search for commerce).

products.name: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)

products.name: Cloud Load Balancing

products.name: Cloud CDN
products.summary: Content delivery using Google's edge caches, integrated with external Application Load Balancers.

products.name: Media CDN
products.summary: Media and large-file delivery on YouTube's edge infrastructure.

products.name: Cloud Armor
products.summary: WAF, DDoS protection, rate limiting and bot management for load-balanced applications.

products.name: Cloud DNS

products.name: Cloud NAT

products.name: Cloud VPN

products.name: Cloud Interconnect

products.name: Cloud Router

products.name: Network Connectivity Center

products.name: Private Service Connect

products.name: Cloud Next Generation Firewall

products.name: Cloud IDS

products.name: Secure Web Proxy

products.name: Cloud Service Mesh

products.name: Apigee API Management

products.name: Cloud Endpoints
